crack: visible crack damage on bridge or concrete surface
alligator_crack: alligator crack pattern with connected branching cracks
wetspot: wet spot or water seepage mark on concrete
efflorescence: white efflorescence deposit on concrete surface
rockpocket: honeycomb or rock pocket defect on concrete
cavity: hole or cavity defect on concrete surface
spalling: spalling concrete with broken or missing surface material
restformwork: remaining formwork material attached to concrete
